_meta.name: Starwatcher Editorial Data Art Tokens (Final Integrated v9.1.6.5)
_meta.description: Complete visual foundation for the Starwatcher constellation viewer. Every color, font, spacing, shadow, motion, elevation, and responsive value. Two themes: 'press_on_light' (primary) and 'cosmic_dark' (alternative).
_meta.usage: Import into your CSS-in-JS, Tailwind config, or build pipeline. Token names are semantic (what it's for) not visual (what it looks like). All values are final — do not override without updating this file.
companion_files: starwatcher-contract.ts   — integration contract (props, events, data model)
changelog_v9: Fixed text_muted contrast to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 on panel backgrounds
Added separate focus ring colors per theme for reliable 3:1 focus visibility
Replaced fixed isolation_halo color with dynamic status-color semantic
Updated node_sizing to 12–24px range for touch accessibility (44px hit area)
Added sqrt scale_formula option for thesis-score sizing
Added explicit dark-mode status colors (no more underspecified desaturation rule)
Added canvas_typography mapping for node/cluster/tooltip text
Added filter_diff tokens for draft vs applied preview states
Formalized reduced_motion behavior as explicit token section
changelog_v9_1: Added skeleton tokens for initial_load and transitioning states
Added stale_indicator component tokens and elevation layer
No breaking changes to existing v9 palettes/spacing; v9.1 is additive
changelog_v9_1_2: Resolved z-index collision: stale_indicator now sits below panels (zIndex 90)
Added elevation + zIndex token for progressive_disclosure indicator
changelog_v9_1_3: Added overlay_stacks.top_right_pills to prevent stale_indicator/progressive_disclosure overlap
Documented top-right pill stacking: prefer overlay_stacks over hardcoded offsets
No breaking changes; additive layout primitives
changelog_v9_1_4: Removed/renamed legacy per-component offsets in favor of overlay_stacks.top_right_pills (prevents accidental magic-number positioning).
Deprecated fixed cluster_border color token; cluster borders are dynamic dominant-status color with a fixed opacity (see contract/status-map).
changelog_v9_1_6: No visual token changes; version bump to align with backend reference implementation and contract clarifications.

color._comment: ———— PRIMARY BRAND ————  Teal is the signature color of Press On Ventures. Used for interactive elements, selected states, thesis-score glow, and edge rendering.

primary._usage: base → buttons, links, selected borders, legend highlights, edge color. 50–100 → subtle backgrounds. 700–900 → text on light backgrounds. base_dark_mode → replaces base in cosmic_dark theme for WCAG AA contrast.

color._comment_neutral: ———— NEUTRAL ————  Grays for text, backgrounds, borders, structural elements.

neutral._usage: Light → 0:page bg, 50:card bg, 200:borders, 700:body text, 900:headings. Dark → 950:page bg, 900:card bg, 700:borders, 200:body text, 50:headings.

color._comment_status: ———— PIPELINE STATUS ————  Each deal stage has a unique color. Used in nodes, legend chips, inspect panel header, and cluster dominant-color rendering. Must stay in sync with starwatcher-status-map.ts. Access via PipelineStatusId, not Notion label strings.

tracking.label: Tracking
tracking.meaning: On the radar, not active now

committed.label: Committed
committed.meaning: Decided to invest, deal in progress

lost.label: Lost
lost.meaning: Wanted to invest, lost the deal

color._comment_semantic: ———— SEMANTIC ————  UI feedback colors. Used for toasts, alerts, form validation.
color._comment_dataviz: ———— DATA VISUALIZATION ————  Edge, glow, halo, and cluster colors. Separate from status colors.

dataviz._isolation_halo_note: Isolation halo color is ALWAYS the node's own status color at isolation_halo_opacity. There is no fixed color — it is computed at runtime from STATUS_COLOR_MAP[theme][status]. This value was previously a hardcoded teal; that was incorrect.
dataviz._cluster_border_note: Cluster border color is the dominant status color; apply opacity cluster_border_opacity (0.40).

typography._comment: ———— FONTS ————  Editorial aesthetic: refined serif headings, clean sans body, monospace for data. Load via Google Fonts: Instrument+Serif&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500

fontFamily.heading: 'Instrument Serif', 'Georgia', serif
fontFamily._note: Instrument Serif for the 'editorial' feel. DM Sans for data labels (highly legible at small sizes). JetBrains Mono for IDs, scores, and technical content.

fontSize._usage: xs → node labels on canvas. sm → captions, metadata. base → body text. lg → panel headers. 2xl → page headings. 3xl → hero/welcome only.

letterSpacing._usage: caps → small uppercase labels (status chips, section headers, legend categories).

canvas_typography._comment: Mapping of font tokens to canvas-rendered text elements. These are rendered by Deck.gl TextLayer, not CSS — values here are used to configure the layer.

spacing._comment: 4px base unit. All spacing must be a multiple of this value.

shadows._comment: Layered shadow system. Must match the elevation tokens below.
shadows._usage: sm → status chips, small cards. md → inspect panel, sidebar. lg → modals, command palette. xl → share modal. glow → high-thesis nodes. glow_strong → selected + high thesis.

radius._usage: sm → inputs, table cells. md → cards, panels. lg → modals. full → node shapes, avatar badges, status chips.

motion._comment: All animations MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion. If enabled, skip all non-essential animations (shimmer, glow pulse, crossfade) — only preserve position changes that convey information (camera movement to a searched node).

duration._usage: instant → hover state changes. fast → tooltip show/hide, button feedback. normal → panel open/close, filter transitions. slow → camera pan to searched node. camera → cluster zoom-in animation.

easing._usage: default → most transitions. out → panel/modal entry. in → panel/modal exit. spring → node selection bounce, toast entry.

camera._note: All camera animations (pan-to-node, cluster zoom, permalink restore) MUST be interruptible. If the user pans or zooms during an animation, the animation stops immediately and the user takes control.

reduced_motion._comment: When reducedMotion prop is true (detected from system preference), these overrides apply.
reduced_motion._note: Essential camera repositioning (navigate-to-node, zoom-to-cluster) still occurs but snaps rather than interpolating. All decorative animations are fully disabled.

elevation._comment: Z-index and shadow layering for stacked UI elements. Higher z-index = closer to the user.

modals._note: Command palette, share modal. Uses backdrop blur.
modals.backdrop_perf_note: backdrop-filter on top of WebGL canvas can cause frame drops on low-end GPUs. Fall back to a solid semi-transparent overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) if the user's device reports < 30fps during the blur.

toasts._note: Toast notifications. Highest layer — always visible over modals.

stale_indicator._note: Data freshness pill. Lives on the canvas overlay layer (below panels and modals) so it does not pierce modal backdrops.

mini_map._note: Optional mini-map overlay. Above legend/tray, below panels and modals.

progressive_disclosure._note: Thesis visibility indicator pill. Stacks below panels/modals, above legend/tray, and should not collide with stale_indicator.

focus._note: Applied to every interactive element on :focus-visible. ring_color_light uses primary-700 for reliable ≥7:1 contrast on white/light surfaces. ring_color_dark uses base_dark_mode for contrast on dark surfaces. Previous single-color approach (primary base #0FA68A) was borderline at ~3.1:1 on white.

density._comment: Controls UI compactness. 'comfortable' is default for overview browsing. 'compact' for data-table and comparison views.

breakpoints._comment: Responsive breakpoints. The component adapts layout at each threshold.

_responsive_behaviors.below_mobile: Canvas fills full viewport. Inspect panel becomes a bottom sheet (50% height, draggable to 90%). Legend collapses to a single-row horizontal scroll. Selection tray becomes a floating pill. Context menu uses bottom sheet pattern. Command palette fills full width.
_responsive_behaviors.mobile_to_tablet: Canvas takes 60% width, inspect panel is a slide-over from the right (40% width). Legend is a collapsible sidebar section.
_responsive_behaviors.above_tablet: Canvas and inspect panel side-by-side. Legend floats as an overlay on the canvas. Full toolbar visible.

node_sizing._comment: How node visual size scales with thesis score and LOD level. Updated v9: minimum 12px radius ensures 24px diameter for reliable 44px touch targets with padding.
node_sizing._scale_note: Square-root scaling ensures high-thesis nodes are visually prominent. A node with thesisScore 0.0 renders at 12px radius (24px diameter). A node with 1.0 renders at 24px radius (48px diameter). The sqrt curve gives a gentle ramp that emphasizes top-tier companies.

hit_area._note: Regardless of visual radius, the interactive hit area for tap/click must be at least 44px diameter (WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size). Pad the hit area if the visual radius is smaller.

filter_diff._comment: Visual tokens for the Draft vs Applied filter preview state. When a draft filter set is pending, nodes that would be filtered out are dimmed and nodes that would newly appear get a preview pulse.
filter_diff._note: When draft is present: dim all nodes that WOULD be filtered out to dimmed_opacity. Show a ghost outline at ghost_outline_opacity for nodes that would newly appear. Preview pulse animates the border of newly-appearing nodes. v9.1.1: preview_pulse_border_webgl added for canvas usage; preview_pulse_border_css retained for DOM.

preview_pulse_border_webgl._note: Use these values for WebGL/Deck.gl layers; CSS variables do not apply on canvas.

status_chip._comment: Status chips must NOT use status color as text color — it fails WCAG AA on tinted backgrounds. Use this chip pattern instead.
status_chip.accent: status-colored dot (6px circle) or miniature shape icon to the left of the label
status_chip._note: The accent dot/shape reinforces the shape encoding for colorblind users. Never use the status base color as text.

themes._comment: Theme-specific surface overrides. Token values above are the 'press_on_light' defaults.

press_on_light._text_muted_note: v9: darkened from #868E96 to #5C636A. Previous value gave ~3.15:1 contrast on panel_bg (#F8F9FA) — below WCAG AA 4.5:1. New value gives ~5.5:1.

cosmic_dark._note: In dark mode: primary teal shifts to #2DB299 for WCAG AA contrast. Status colors use explicit base_dark values from color.status (no ad-hoc desaturation). Semantic background colors use the dark_bg values from color.status.

skeleton._comment: Loading skeleton visual primitives for the constellation canvas. Use reduced_motion to disable shimmer.

initial_load._note: Render placeholder nodes + subtle shimmer while WebGL layers initialize and data loads.

transitioning._note: Use a top-edge bar while filters/search cause layout transitions.

overlay_stacks._comment: Layout primitives for stacking multiple overlay elements without hardcoded offsets.

top_right_pills._comment: Used for stacking stale_indicator + progressive_disclosure (and future pills).
top_right_pills._note: Render as a vertical flex/stack container. First child is topmost. Keep below panels (100) so slide-overs can cover it.

stale_indicator._comment: Top-right data freshness indicator. Intended to be subtle but noticeable.
stale_indicator._note: If stale=false, hide. If stale=true, show message + optional action (e.g., Refresh). Prefer rendering inside overlay_stacks.top_right_pills; offset is legacy fallback. (v9.1.4: 'offset' renamed to '_legacy_offset' — prefer overlay_stacks.top_right_pills positioning.)

mini_map._comment: Optional overview mini-map for large constellations. Simplified dots + viewport rectangle.
mini_map._note: Mini-map should be click-to-pan; double-click zooms. Keep it cheap: no icons, no labels.

progressive_disclosure._comment: Indicator shown when thesis threshold hides nodes. Communicates hidden count + optional actions.
progressive_disclosure._note: Offset assumes stale_indicator occupies top-right; adjust if stale indicator is hidden. zIndex is defined in elevation.progressive_disclosure. Prefer rendering inside overlay_stacks.top_right_pills; offset is legacy fallback. (v9.1.4: 'offset' renamed to '_legacy_offset' — prefer overlay_stacks.top_right_pills positioning.)
